1.consolidated_definition: Armazón, generalmente de madera, con que se da forma a un elemento estructural de hormigón armado, como una viga o una columna.
1.en_consolidated_definition: Formwork, typically made of wood, used to give shape to a structural element of reinforced concrete, such as a beam or a column.
